ObjectName.value: Oeuvre pour salon by Basile Morin, 2003 - framed abstract acrylic painting with blue rectangles on a wall

Categories.value: Abstract paintings|Op art|Framed paintings|Self-published work|Blue rectangles|Paintings with blue|Acrylic on canvas|Photographs by Basile Morin|Paintings by Basile Morin

ImageDescription.value: Abstract painting called Artwork for living room (Oeuvre pour salon in French) by Basile Morin, 2003. Made in Toulouse, France. Framed acrylic canva with blue rectangles. Influences: Piet Mondrian, Victor Vasarely. We can see this as an eye like a window: the light blue part depicts the sight and the white square the opening. In 2020, by chance, strong similarities were found with the composition of this photograph.
